name: facet
description: An autonomous machine learning team for every task: it builds, checks and serves a model.

interface.shortDescription: An autonomous ML team that builds a model for one task, better than a frontier model at it
interface.longDescription: Describe a narrow, repeated task and Facet's agent builds a model for it on its own, checks every change against plain-language Expectations, and serves it through an OpenAI-compatible API. You approve each quote before anything runs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Make a Facet Task for this classification step and show me what it would cost to make it better
